title: Glowing island with a palm tree
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#00ffcc' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#00ffcc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe082'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d4a017'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Sky glow behind tree -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='28' fill='#00ffcc' opacity='0.08'/>

  <!-- Water -->
  <rect x='5' y='62' width='90' height='30' rx='6' fill='#1565c0'/>
  <rect x='5' y='62' width='90' height='8' rx='4' fill='#42a5f5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Island sand -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='12' fill='url(#sand)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='9' fill='#ffe082'/>

  <!-- Palm trunk -->
  <path d='M48 64 Q46 50 44 38 Q43 34 46 32 Q48 34 49 38 Q51 50 52 64 Z' fill='#8d6e3a'/>
  <path d='M48.5 64 Q47 50 45 38' stroke='#bcaaa4' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Fronds -->
  <g fill='#00e676' stroke='#00ffcc' stroke-width='0.8'>
    <path d='M46 33 Q34 24 22 28 Q34 30 44 34 Z'/>
    <path d='M46 33 Q36 20 26 16 Q36 24 44 32 Z'/>
    <path d='M46 33 Q52 18 62 14 Q54 24 48 32 Z'/>
    <path d='M46 33 Q60 24 72 26 Q60 30 48 34 Z'/>
    <path d='M46 33 Q38 32 30 38 Q38 34 45 35 Z'/>
    <path d='M46 33 Q56 32 64 38 Q54 34 47 35 Z'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Frond highlights -->
  <g stroke='#69f0ae' stroke-width='0.7' fill='none' opacity='0.6'>
    <path d='M45 32 Q36 25 26 28'/>
    <path d='M45 32 Q52 22 60 18'/>
    <path d='M45 32 Q58 26 68 27'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Coconuts -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='2.2' fill='#5d4037'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='36' r='2.2' fill='#4e342e'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='33' r='2' fill='#6d4c41'/>

  <!-- Water sparkles -->
  <g fill='#80d8ff' opacity='0.8'>
    <circle cx='22' cy='78' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='35' cy='82' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='79' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='75' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='76' r='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Palm tree glow dots -->
  <g fill='#00ffcc' opacity='0.9'>
    <circle cx='44' cy='24' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='21' r='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='17' r='0.8'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='29' r='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='36' r='0.7'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='0.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Star in sky -->
  <g fill='#e0f7fa' opacity='0.8'>
    <polygon points='82,18 83.5,22 88,22 84.5,25 86,29 82,26.5 78,29 79.5,25 76,22 80.5,22'/>
    <polygon points='20,14 21,16 23,16 21.5,17.5 22,19.5 20,18 18,19.5 18.5,17.5 17,16 19,16' transform='scale(0.9) translate(2,1)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sun/moon glow -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='5' fill='#fff9c4' opacity='0.3'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='3' fill='#fff9c4' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
